name: @retorika/publisher
description: Packages the site: HTML, CSS, images, sitemap, ZIP
comment: No third-party runtime dependency beyond the font packages of the gallery, whose bytes are the deliverable: the woff2 files travel into the client's ZIP exactly as @fontsource ships them, and no family here reserves the name it is presented under — a condition `test/fonts.test.ts` asserts over every row against the holders' own licence texts in `licences/`, never the package's rebuilt LICENSE, since the latin slice we ship is a Modified Version under the OFL and §3 would not let a reserved name travel with it (ADR 0045, amended sprint 29). The ZIP itself is written by hand against node:zlib rather than pulled from a supply chain.
